elution.heroLead: Advanced Gold Recovery. Reliable Processing. Trusted Partnership.
elution.heroCapacity: High-pressure, high-temperature systems engineered for continuous operations — with capacities of up to 1,000 kg per cycle.
elution.introLead: JEMA Elution is a specialized gold recovery and processing business under JEMA Africa, focused on providing efficient and reliable elution services for mining operations.
elution.introP1: We specialize in the recovery of gold from activated carbon using advanced elution technology designed to deliver efficient processing, consistent performance, and timely results. Our high-pressure and high-temperature processing systems are engineered for continuous operations and can handle capacities of up to 1,000 kg per cycle.
elution.introP2: With strategically located facilities in key mining regions of Tanzania, JEMA Elution is positioned to provide accessible, dependable, and responsive services to both small-scale and large-scale mining operations.

service0.title: Gold Recovery & Elution Processing
service0.text: We provide professional elution services designed to efficiently recover gold from activated carbon. Our operations combine modern equipment, experienced personnel, and controlled processing procedures to deliver reliable recovery results.

service1.title: High-Capacity Processing
service1.text: Our modern elution machines are designed for 24-hour continuous operation, allowing us to process substantial volumes efficiently. With processing capacity of up to 1,000 kg per cycle, our facilities are equipped to support demanding mining operations.

service2.title: Recovery Optimization
service2.text: We use advanced monitoring and process-control practices to optimize the recovery process and maintain consistent operational performance. Our objective is to maximize recovery efficiency while delivering predictable and reliable processing outcomes.

service3.title: Plant Maintenance & Operational Reliability
service3.text: Regular inspection and maintenance of our equipment is an important part of our operations. By maintaining our machines and processing facilities, we work to minimize downtime, improve equipment performance, and maintain continuity of service.

service4.title: Professional Client Support
service4.text: Our commitment extends beyond processing. We provide dedicated customer support, proactive communication, and technical assistance to help clients receive reliable service throughout the processing cycle.

reason01.title: Established & Stable Organization
reason01.text: JEMA Africa was established in 2012 and has developed into a diversified African business operating across mining, logistics, technology, education, and other sectors. This established foundation supports our commitment to long-term business relationships and dependable service delivery.

reason02.title: Advanced Processing Technology
reason02.text: Our elution facilities utilize modern high-pressure and high-temperature technology designed to improve processing efficiency, shorten processing times, and support consistent gold recovery. Our equipment is designed for continuous 24-hour operation with a capacity of up to 1,000 kg per cycle.

reason03.title: Reliable Operations
reason03.text: We prioritize equipment reliability and operational continuity through regular machine maintenance and monitoring. Our facilities are also supported by standby power solutions to help minimize interruptions during power outages.

reason04.title: Strategic Mining Locations
reason04.text: Our presence in major mining regions allows us to remain close to our clients and respond efficiently to their operational requirements.

reason05.title: Experienced Professionals
reason05.text: Our operations are supported by experienced personnel with practical knowledge of elution and gold recovery processes. This enables us to maintain professional operating standards and provide clients with dependable processing services.

reason06.title: Transparency & Accountability
reason06.text: Transparency is fundamental to the way we conduct business. We emphasize clear communication, accountability, timely updates, and transparent pricing throughout our engagement with clients.

reason07.title: Competitive & Cost-Effective Solutions
reason07.text: We aim to provide high-quality processing services at competitive rates. Our approach is focused on delivering value to clients while maintaining professional operational and service standards.

reason08.title: Security & Controlled Handling
reason08.text: We recognize the importance of security throughout the gold recovery process. Our facilities incorporate CCTV monitoring and controlled handling procedures designed to safeguard client materials and support secure operations.

elution.techIntro: At JEMA Elution, technology is at the heart of our operations. Our high-capacity elution systems are designed to provide:
elution.techOutro: Our investment in modern equipment and continuous operational improvements enables us to serve the requirements of today's mining industry.
elution.sustainP1: We recognize the importance of responsible mining and environmentally conscious operations.
elution.sustainP2: Our recovery approach is designed with operational efficiency and resource management in mind. We seek to optimize the use of water and processing chemicals while maintaining effective recovery performance and responsible operating practices.
elution.sustainP3: As part of JEMA Africa's broader commitment to sustainable and impactful business development, we continue to focus on solutions that create long-term value for our clients, communities, and the mining sector.
elution.trustIntro: At JEMA Elution, we understand that efficient gold recovery is an important part of a successful mining operation. For this reason, we focus on more than processing capacity. We combine:
elution.trustOutro: to provide a complete and dependable elution service. Our goal is to help mining companies achieve efficient processing, minimize operational delays, and maximize the value generated from their gold recovery operations.

chemicals.heroLead: JEMA Chemicals is a specialized mining chemical company under JEMA Africa, dedicated to supplying high-quality mineral processing chemicals and technical solutions to mining operations across Tanzania and the East African region. We deliver reliable products, professional support, and efficient supply chain solutions to small-scale, medium-scale, and large-scale mining companies.
chemicals.partnerP1: Established to meet the growing demands of the mining sector, JEMA Chemicals has become a trusted partner by delivering reliable products, professional support, and efficient supply chain solutions. Our commitment is to ensure that mining operations receive the right products, at the right time, and in the right quantities to maintain productivity and operational efficiency.
chemicals.partnerP2: JEMA Chemicals operates as an importer, distributor, storage provider, transporter, and exporter of mining chemicals, supported by a strong network of branches strategically located in major mining regions across Tanzania.

pillar01.title: Strategic Partnerships
pillar01.text: We collaborate with international manufacturers, suppliers, and technology providers to ensure access to quality products, industry expertise, and best practices. Our partnerships enable us to deliver consistent product quality and competitive pricing to our clients.

pillar02.title: Safety, Compliance & Responsible Operations
pillar02.text: Safety and compliance are integral parts of our operations. JEMA Chemicals adheres to applicable local regulations and industry standards governing the importation, storage, transportation, and handling of chemicals. We promote responsible chemical use and support environmentally conscious practices throughout our operations.

pillar03.title: Strategic Branch Network
pillar03.text: JEMA Chemicals operates branches in key mining regions — Mwanza, Geita, Kahama, Musoma, Chunya, and Mpanda — to ensure faster service, product availability, and responsive customer support. Our proximity to mining communities enables us to understand local industry requirements and provide tailored solutions.

chemicals.purposeP1: Mining operations require a dependable supply of quality chemicals to achieve optimal recovery, efficient processing, and sustainable production. At JEMA Chemicals, our mission is to bridge the gap between global chemical manufacturers and local mining operations.
chemicals.purposeP2: We understand that uninterrupted chemical supply is critical to mining success. Therefore, we invest in inventory management, logistics, storage facilities, and branch networks that ensure timely product availability and reduced operational downtime.

feature0.title: Premium Mining Chemicals
feature0.text: JEMA Chemicals supplies a comprehensive range of chemicals used in mineral processing, gold extraction, water treatment, and metallurgical operations.

feature1.title: Global Sourcing & Supply Chain
feature1.text: We import products from internationally recognized manufacturers in South Korea, China, India, and Sri Lanka, ensuring consistent product quality and competitive pricing.

feature2.title: Strategic Locations
feature2.text: Our branch network in major mining towns ensures timely product availability and responsive customer support across Tanzania.

feature3.title: Technical Support & Consultancy
feature3.text: More than a supplier — a technical partner. Our team provides product selection guidance, usage recommendations, process optimization advice, and operational support.

chemicals.productsLead: JEMA Chemicals supplies a comprehensive range of chemicals used in mineral processing, gold extraction, water treatment, and metallurgical operations. From sodium cyanide for gold extraction to grinding balls for ore processing, our products are designed to deliver the highest efficiency and quality.

product0.name: Sodium Cyanide
product0.desc: Widely used in gold extraction processes, playing a vital role in maximizing gold recovery efficiency.

product1.name: Activated Carbon
product1.desc: High-quality activated carbon used in gold adsorption and recovery processes, supporting efficient extraction and improved plant performance.

product2.name: Flocculants
product2.desc: Used in water clarification, tailings treatment, and mineral processing operations to improve separation efficiency.

product3.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
product3.desc: Used in ore treatment processes, detoxification applications, and process optimization.

product4.name: Sodium Metabisulfite
product4.desc: Used for cyanide detoxification and environmental management processes.

product5.name: Caustic Soda
product5.desc: Essential for pH regulation and process control in mining operations.

product6.name: Grinding Balls
product6.desc: High-quality grinding media used in ball mills to improve ore size reduction and processing efficiency.

chemicals.whyText: Our commitment to quality, a robust network of branches in major mining towns, and a team of industry experts ensure that you receive tailored solutions for your operations. We build long-term relationships based on trust, responsiveness, and reliability.

faq0.q: What makes JEMA Chemicals different from other suppliers?
faq0.a: We combine high-quality products sourced from internationally recognized manufacturers with personalized technical support and a strategic branch network across Tanzania. Our presence in major mining towns ensures quick access to chemicals, backed by a dedicated team ready to support your operations.

faq1.q: How do you ensure the quality of your mining chemicals?
faq1.a: Quality is our top priority. We source products from trusted manufacturers in South Korea, China, India, and Sri Lanka, ensuring they meet industry standards. Our team provides ongoing technical support to ensure chemicals perform effectively in your applications.

faq2.q: Can JEMA Chemicals support large-scale mining operations?
faq2.a: Absolutely. With our extensive inventory, strategic branch locations in Mwanza, Geita, Kahama, Musoma, Chunya, and Mpanda, and logistics expertise, we are equipped to handle the needs of small, medium, and large-scale mining operations with efficiency and reliability.

faq3.q: What services do you offer beyond supplying chemicals?
faq3.a: In addition to product supply, we provide technical consultations, product selection guidance, chemical application support, process optimization advice, and operational support. We also maintain storage facilities, transportation services, and distribution networks to ensure timely delivery.

chemicals.consultText: At JEMA Chemicals, we believe that providing products alone is not enough. Our team works closely with clients to provide product selection guidance, chemical application support, usage recommendations, process optimization advice, technical consultations, and operational support.
chemicals.teamText: Our team is the backbone of Jema Chemicals. With extensive industry knowledge and a passion for innovation, they are dedicated to delivering the best solutions for our clients. From branch leads across Tanzania to operations and marketing specialists, we are here to make your mining journey seamless.

jit.heroLead: Jema Institute of Technology (JIT) is a technology-driven technical and vocational education institution established to develop practical skills, technical expertise, innovation, and professional competence for Tanzania's evolving workforce. Owned by JEMA Africa Limited, JIT combines academic learning with hands-on training to prepare students for employment, entrepreneurship, innovation, and lifelong professional development.

pillar1.title: Our Vision
pillar1.text: To be a technology-driven institution that transforms industries and contributes to sustainable national economic development. Our vision reflects our belief that technical education is an important driver of industrialization, technological advancement, and economic transformation.

pillar2.title: Our Mission
pillar2.text: To improve lives by integrating technology into the daily livelihood of communities, expanding digital knowledge, and promoting creativity and innovation for a better tomorrow. We pursue this mission by providing practical education, developing technical competencies, encouraging innovation, and creating opportunities for students and professionals to acquire skills relevant to modern industry.

pillar3.title: Our Core Values
pillar3.text: Our values guide how we teach, work, lead and engage with our students, partners and communities — Integrity, Professionalism, Respect, Innovation, Excellence, Interdependence, and Competence-Based Education.

jit.aboutP1: Jema Institute of Technology was established by JEMA Africa to contribute to the development of technical education and professional skills in Tanzania. JEMA Africa's experience across mining, technology, business and industrial operations provides JIT with an important connection to real-world industry requirements.
jit.aboutP2: Today, JIT provides a learning environment where students can develop both theoretical understanding and practical capabilities. Our educational model is designed around four key outcomes:
jit.aboutP3: JIT is located at the JEMA Tech Building in Mkuyuni Industrial Area, Mwanza, strategically positioned within an environment connected to technology, mining, business, and industrial activities.
jit.highlightsEyebrow: Invest in Education for Future Generations
jit.highlightsLead: At JIT, we believe that education should do more than provide academic knowledge. It should equip people with the practical capabilities, confidence, creativity, and technological skills required to solve real-world problems and contribute meaningfully to society.

highlight0.title: Competency-Based Education
highlight0.text: We focus on developing practical capabilities that students can apply in real working environments. Our educational model is designed around four key outcomes: Knowledge, Skills, Innovation, and Employability — preparing graduates for employment, entrepreneurship, innovation, and professional success.

highlight1.title: Modern Learning Facilities
highlight1.text: JIT provides facilities designed to support theoretical instruction, practical learning, technology development, and student activities. Our learning environment includes modern laboratories, classrooms, technical training facilities, library resources, ICT infrastructure, research facilities, innovation spaces, and a gold-processing elution plant that provides students with practical industrial exposure.

highlight2.title: Practical & Competency-Based Learning
highlight2.text: One of JIT's key strengths is its emphasis on practical learning. Our approach incorporates laboratory sessions, practical assignments, technical demonstrations, field exposure, industrial practical training, project-based learning, technology-based learning, and research and innovation activities.

highlight3.title: Student Innovation Hub
highlight3.text: The JIT Student Innovation Hub provides a platform for students to explore ideas, develop projects, and experiment with technology. Through the Innovation Hub, students can develop digital solutions, technical projects, entrepreneurship ideas, research projects, prototypes, and technology-based solutions.

highlight4.title: Research & Innovation
highlight4.text: JIT recognizes research and innovation as essential components of modern technical education. Our research and innovation activities encourage students and staff to identify real-world challenges and develop practical solutions using technology, science and technical knowledge.

highlight5.title: Industry Connection
highlight5.text: JIT benefits from its relationship with JEMA Africa and the group's diverse business operations across mining, technology, logistics, education, automotive, chemicals and financial services. This connection is particularly valuable in technical disciplines where students need to understand how their knowledge is applied in real operating environments.

jit.valueLead: From practical education and modern laboratories to experienced lecturers, industry-relevant programmes, research & innovation, and technology-enabled learning — JIT is committed to providing education that is relevant, practical, and responsive to the changing needs of society and industry.
jit.value0: Knowledge — Understanding the principles behind a profession.
jit.value1: Skills — Developing practical competence through hands-on learning.
jit.value2: Innovation — Encouraging creativity and technology-driven problem-solving.
jit.value3: Employability — Preparing graduates to contribute effectively to the workplace or establish their own ventures.
jit.teamText: It is with great pride and enthusiasm that I welcome you to JEMA Institute of Technology. JIT is a place where innovation meets excellence, and where aspiring professionals are given the opportunity to develop the knowledge, technical skills, and confidence required to contribute to the future of technology and industry. We are committed to creating an environment where students can learn, experiment, innovate and develop into responsible professionals. Your potential is the beginning. Your skills are the foundation. Your innovation can shape the future.
jit.contactText: Whether you are a recent secondary school graduate, a professional seeking additional skills, an organization looking to train your workforce, or an aspiring entrepreneur, JIT provides opportunities to develop practical knowledge and professional capabilities.

finance.heroLead: JETFinance is a digital microfinance platform designed to empower underserved communities by providing access to essential financial services. Launched as an initiative by Jema Africa Limited, JETFinance aims to bridge the gap in financial inclusion for groups such as Vicoba and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Tanzania.
finance.visionText: To be the leading digital microfinance provider in Tanzania, driving financial inclusion and economic growth through innovative solutions and exceptional customer service.
finance.missionText: To empower underserved communities by providing accessible, affordable, and innovative financial services that foster economic growth and improve quality of life.
finance.aboutP1: Jema Financial Services, launched by Jema Africa Limited, is a digital microfinance platform designed to enhance financial inclusion for underserved communities.
finance.aboutP2: Through Jema Financial Services, the platform offers essential financial services to groups such as Vicoba (Village Community Banks) and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Tanzania.
finance.aboutP3: Jema Financial Service seeks to bridge the financial inclusion gap by enabling these communities to access affordable loans, savings, and other crucial financial tools.
finance.aboutP4: The platform leverages technology to simplify the borrowing process, making financial services accessible to individuals and businesses previously excluded from traditional banking systems.
finance.aboutP5: With a focus on empowering marginalized groups, Jema Financial Services contributes to fostering economic growth and self-reliance.
finance.offeringsLead: Jema Financial Services is committed to revolutionizing financial services in Tanzania. With a strong focus on innovation, customer-centricity, and financial education, we aim to create lasting value for our users and contribute to the broader economic development of the country.

offering0.title: Trade Finance Loans
offering0.text: We provide financial assistance to small and medium-sized companies to help them fulfill orders, such as clients from our sister company, Jema Chemicals.

offering1.title: Vicoba Group Support
offering1.text: Our flagship product, the JETFinance Vicoba App, streamlines operations for Vicoba groups, offering secure financial data storage, loan access, and financial education.

offering2.title: Financial Education
offering2.text: We offer training modules to improve financial literacy among our clients, empowering them to make informed financial decisions and build a solid credit history.

offering3.title: Innovative Financial Solutions
offering3.text: By leveraging technology, we provide user-friendly financial services that cater to the specific needs of underserved communities, ensuring accessibility and affordability.

finance.ctaTitle: We aim to revolutionize the financial landscape
finance.whyP1: Jema Financial Services is dedicated to offering more than just financial support. We focus on financial education, helping our clients build their credit scores and access various loan products from Jema Financial Services and its partners.
finance.whyP2: Our goal is to promote sustainable development by empowering individuals and businesses with the necessary tools and knowledge to thrive economically.
finance.whyP3: Jema Financial Services was established to address the financial needs of underrepresented groups in our community.
finance.whyP4: Recognizing the challenges faced by SMEs and Vicoba groups in accessing financial services, Jema Financial Services provides tailored solutions to foster economic growth and financial independence.
finance.accessLead: At Jema Financial Services, we understand the challenges faced by underserved communities when it comes to accessing financial products. That's why Jema Financial Services is designed to simplify the process and make financial services as accessible as possible.

accessFeature0.label: Easy Registration
accessFeature0.text: Users can easily sign up on our platform through a simple and secure registration process, providing access to a variety of financial products.

accessFeature1.label: Mobile-Based Platform
accessFeature1.text: Jema Financial Services is a mobile-first platform that allows individuals and businesses to access financial services from the convenience of their smartphones, making it easier for them to manage their finances on the go.

accessFeature2.label: Loan Application Process
accessFeature2.text: The loan application process is straightforward and quick. Applicants can apply for loans directly through their mobile devices, and funds can be disbursed promptly once approved.

accessFeature3.label: Flexible Repayment Terms
accessFeature3.text: Jema Financial Services offers flexible repayment plans to suit the financial situations of individuals and small businesses, helping them manage their cash flow and repay loans without undue hardship.

accessFeature4.label: 24/7 Customer Support
accessFeature4.text: Our dedicated customer support team is available around the clock to assist users with any questions or issues they may encounter while using the platform.

jione.heroLead: Jema Jione is a premier logistics company, dedicated to providing comprehensive and reliable logistics solutions across East and Central Africa. With a modern fleet and a team of highly skilled professionals, we are equipped to handle a diverse range of cargo, from chemical products to farm produce. Our commitment to excellence, safety, and efficiency ensures that your goods reach their destination swiftly and securely.

pillar0.text: Our experienced team understands logistics complexities and delivers exceptional service.

pillar1.title: State-of-the-Art Technology
pillar1.text: Advanced fleet management and real-time tracking ensure your cargo is secure and on the move.

pillar2.title: Customer-Centric Approach
pillar2.text: Tailored solutions meet specific client requirements, building trust and reliability.

jione.rightLead: Choosing Jema Jione means opting for reliability, efficiency, and a customer-centric approach. Trust Jema Jione for all your logistics needs and experience the difference in quality and service.
